# Meteor 1.21.11 build 82

The official snapshot Maven directory retains only build 86. This local Maven repository preserves build 82 for reproducible compilation and compatibility checks. The dependency is not bundled into Comet's mod JAR; players install Meteor themselves. The Comet source archive includes this directory together with the matching upstream source for build 82.

- Artifact: `maven/meteordevelopment/meteor-client/1.21.11-82/meteor-client-1.21.11-82.jar`
- Archive source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chukfinley/meteor-archive/9eccf7f2e6b40da8d1ebb502f2675ebfea743fa1/meteor-client/meteor-client-1.21.11-82.jar
- SHA-256: `d4f711420ed6a096041eb8e1f012ddd59fa376b7424f4c39b45eca41429dc74f`
- Version and upstream commit recorded in the JAR: `1.21.11-82`, `7fc97a87f9b9108b4bf462e08129a6b2ae47350b`.
- Upstream source: https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/tree/7fc97a87f9b9108b4bf462e08129a6b2ae47350b
- Upstream source archive: https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/archive/7fc97a87f9b9108b4bf462e08129a6b2ae47350b.tar.gz
- License: GPL-3.0 (see the upstream source).

The accompanying POM was reconstructed using the dependencies in the upstream build at that commit and the JAR's nested library versions. It is local build metadata, not an upstream-published POM.

## Corresponding Meteor source

`meteor-client-1.21.11-82-source.tar.gz` contains the unmodified upstream source, licence and build files at commit `7fc97a87f9b9108b4bf462e08129a6b2ae47350b`. It is included beside the vendored binary in Comet's source distribution.
